driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic PCAL95555 driver, which owns the standard register map of both chips and the PCAL9555A-only Agile I/O bank, and uses the CRTP I2C interface, which calls the platform port you write, which drives the I2C bus and the INT line of the PCA9555 or PCAL9555A.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application talks to one PCAL95555<I2c> object per chip. The core owns the chip's register map (listed from Pcal95555Reg in inc/pcal95555.hpp): the eight standard registers both chips have, and the Agile I/O bank only the PCAL9555A answers, which the driver guards after it has detected the variant. The communication interface (pcal95555::I2cInterface in inc/pcal95555_i2c_interface.hpp) is a CRTP base: three methods are required, the rest have defaults. The platform port is the only code you write. Below it is the chip.
